adopt: Dispatch one public-safe job to a public mirror's free runner and watch it execute.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
The monorepo's hosted runners are billing-dead and its self-hosted pool is CPU-bound, while the public mirrors run free hosted CI that only ever executes their own sync and publish lanes. The capacity is real and not pooled: nothing routes monorepo public-safe work to it.

Install
pip install awpool

Commands
  awpool

Quick start
  pip install awpool
  awpool peers # who is reachable right now
  awpool status # per-peer model state (warm/cold/unknown)
  awpool pick qwen3-8b # where should it serve from NOW
  awpool warm qwen3-8b # ask that peer to load it
  awpool park qwen3-8b # ask that peer to unload it
synopsis: The free half of the elastic work pool: dispatches public-safe work onto the free GitHub-hosted runners of the public aw* mirrors, so their idle CI minutes become compute. awrun remains the paid/self-hosted lane; this is its free twin.
